SYMPTOM: `useEffect(() => { classList.add(darkTheme); return () => classList.remove(darkTheme); }, [])` causes theme flash in dev and test environments.

CAUSE: React Strict Mode double-invokes effects in development — mount → cleanup → remount. The cleanup removes the class after first mount, leaving the DOM without `darkTheme` applied briefly.

FIX: When applying a permanent/unconditional class, omit the cleanup entirely:
```tsx
useEffect(() => {
  document.documentElement.classList.add(darkTheme);
}, []);
```

PREVENT: Only include cleanup returns for effects that genuinely need reversal (event listeners, subscriptions, timers). Static DOM mutations that are meant to persist don't need cleanup.
